edges.reason: ifAdmin compares msg.sender against ADMIN to decide whether admin entrypoints execute.

implementation() is only readable by the admin caller checked in ifAdmin.
_willFallback requires msg.sender to differ from ADMIN before delegating.
The derived _willFallback ultimately defers to the msg.sender-versus-ADMIN guard.
